about.bio: Hi, I’m Alejandra Cárdenas—a passionate and experienced makeup artist based in Madrid, originally from Bogotá, Colombia. With several years in the beauty industry, I’ve had the privilege of working with a wide range of clients, from high-profile individuals to editorial and commercial projects. I trained at the prestigious Kohl School of Makeup here in Madrid, where I refined my skills and developed a strong eye for detail. My work spans various styles, including beauty, fashion, editorial, and special events. Whether I'm creating a flawless natural look or a bold, artistic transformation, I bring creativity, precision, and professionalism to every project. I speak both Spanish and English fluently, which allows me to collaborate easily with international clients and teams. I’m deeply committed to enhancing natural beauty and adapting my style to suit each client’s vision. If you’re interested in working together, I’d love to hear from you. Let’s bring your ideas to life.

items.quote: Alejandra is a true artist. Her attention to detail and creativity are unmatched. She is a pleasure to work with and always delivers exceptional results.
items.author: - Jane Doe, Model
